chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Aziz al-Abdi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'If cheese harms from everything and does not benefit, then sugar benefits from everything and does not harm from anything.'
ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of sugar according to Imam al-Sadiq (as)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes sugar as a universal remedy (*dawa*) by contrasting it with cheese, which was viewed in early Islamic medicine as heavy and difficult to digest. This comparison reflects the Greco-Arabic medical theories of the time, where sugar was prized for its warming and moistening properties, positioning it as a restorative agent that balances bodily humors without the detrimental effects associated with dairy.
